questions.question: A train, 500 m long, passes a railway platform 400 m long, in one minute with uniform speed. What is the time (in seconds) taken by the train to pass a man riding a motorbike, travelling opposite to the direction of the train, at a speed of 18 km/h?
questions.solution:
Given:

A train, 500 m long, passes a railway platform 400 m long, in one minute with uniform speed.

Speed of man = 18 km/h

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/time

When running in the opposite direction on the parallel track, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂

Calculation:

Total distance = 500 m + 400 m = 900 m

Speed of train in m/sec = 900/60 = 15 m/sec

Relative Speed = 15 + 18 × 5/18 = 15 + 5 = 20 m/sec

Time taken by the train to pass a man riding a motorbike

⇒ Distance/Relative Speed = 500/20

⇒ 25 seconds

questions.question: A man invested Rs.2,400 at 5% and Rs.5,400 at 9% simple interest, What amount (in Rs.) will he get from his investments after 6 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man invested Rs.2,400 at 5% and Rs.5,400 at 9% simple interest

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest(SI) = 1/100 × Principal × Rate × Time

**Calculation:**

Total SI for 6 years = 1/100 × 2400 × 5 × 6 + 1/100 × 5400 × 9 × 6

⇒ 720 + 2916 = 3636

∴ Amount received after 6 years = Principal + SI = 2400 + 5400 + 3636

⇒ Rs. 11436 

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 11436.**

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 27 days and 54 days, respectively. They completed the work in 9 days with the help of C. How many days will C take to complete eight-ninths of the work alone?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 27 days and 54 days, respectively. 

They completed the work in 9 days with the help of C. 

**Concept used:**

Work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM [27, 54] = 54

∴ Efficiency of A = 54/27 = 2 units/day 

Efficiency of B = 54/54 = 1 unit/day 

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 54/9 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of C = Efficiency of (A + B + C) - {Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B} 

Efficiency of C = (6 - {2 + 1}) = 3 units/day

Time taken by C to complete eight-ninths of the work alone = 8/9 × 54/3 = 16 days

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

questions.question: The marked price of a table is Rs.3,000, which is 25% above the cost price. It is sold at a discount of 20% on the marked price. What is the profit or loss percent?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When an article is marked up by a% and given a discount of b%, the net profit or loss % is found using the successive percentage formula.

Net Effect % = a − b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Here, a = 25 (Markup) and b = 20 (Discount).

⇒ Net Effect % = 25 − 20 − (25 × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ Net Effect % = 5 − 500 ÷ 100 = 5 − 5 = 0%

Since the net percentage change is 0%, there is neither profit nor loss. The given marked price is not needed.

**∴ The correct answer is No profit, no loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 3000

Markup = 25% above Cost Price (CP)

Discount = 20% on Marked Price (MP)

**Formula Used:**

CP = MP × 100 ÷ (100 + Markup %)

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount %) ÷ 100

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 95 dozen oranges at Rs. 4.50 each. 7 dozen oranges were rotten and so were discarded. He sold the remaining oranges at Rs. 78 per dozen. What is his profit or loss percent (to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper bought 95 dozen oranges at Rs. 4.50 each. 

7 dozen oranges were rotten and so were discarded. 

He sold the remaining oranges at Rs. 78 per dozen

**Calculation:**

CP of 95 dozen oranges = Rs. 4.50 × 95 × 12 = Rs. 5130

Remaining oranges = 95 - 7 = 88 dozen

SP of 88 dozen oranges = Rs. 78 × 88 = Rs. 6864

∴ Required profit% = [6864 - 5130]/5130 × 100 

⇒ 1734/5130 × 100

⇒ 34%

**∴ The correct answer is 34%.**

questions.question: The daily wages of P, Q and R are in the proportion 5 ∶ 7 ∶ 8. If Q earns Rs.560 per daily, then what are the daily wages (in Rs.) of R and P, respectively?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given **Ratio** P : Q : R = 5 : 7 : 8.

According to the question, Q's share (7 units) = ₹560.

Value of 1 unit = 560 ÷ 7 = ₹80.

Wage of R (8 units) = 8 × 80 = ₹640.

Wage of P (5 units) = 5 × 80 = ₹400.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹640 and ₹400.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of daily wages (P : Q : R) = 5 : 7 : 8

Daily wage of **Q** = ₹560

**Formula Used:**

Actual Value = Ratio part × Constant factor (x)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e178cdd69e4db3c446dbb0cf6873229ee7dd27c5dcd1ea7fcf65f53a32d0ff95.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the daily wages of **P, Q, and R** be 5x, 7x, and 8x respectively.

⇒ 7x = 560

⇒ x = 560 ÷ 7

⇒ x = 80

Now, finding the wages of **R and P**:

⇒ Wage of R = 8x = 8 × 80 = ₹640

⇒ Wage of P = 5x = 5 × 80 = ₹400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹640 and ₹400.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio compares two quantities by division. If a : b = c : d, then a × d = b × c.

Unitary Method

This method involves finding the value of a single unit and then multiplying it by the required number of units to find the desired value.

Total Wage Calculation

Total wage of all persons = (Sum of all ratio parts) × Value of one unit. For P, Q, and R, Total = (5+7+8) × 80 = ₹1600.

questions.question: If 5 tan A = 12, then what is the value of (13 sin A + 20 tan A)/(15 tan A - 13 cos A), where A is an acute angle?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
Given **5 tan A = 12** ⇒ **tan A = 12/5** (Perpendicular/Base).

For a right-angled triangle, **(5, 12, 13)** is a **Pythagorean triplet**, so **Hypotenuse = 13**.

⇒ **sin A = 12/13** and **cos A = 5/13**.

Expression = (13 × 12/13 + 20 × 12/5) ÷ (15 × 12/5 − 13 × 5/13) = (12 + 48) ÷ (36 − 5) = 60/31 = 1(29/31).

**∴ The correct answer is 1(29/31).**

**__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0657b7a9e42603e79f09e9d5896ba367ba43e3c0bd063f0047b2c77dea2e3375.png] 
**Given:** 5 tan A = 12 ⇒ tan A = 12/5

**Formula Used:** tan A = P/B, sin A = P/H, cos A = B/H

⇒ Let **Perpendicular (P)** = 12 and **Base (B)** = 5.

⇒ **Hypotenuse (H)** = √(12² + 5²) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13.

⇒ **sin A** = 12/13

⇒ **cos A** = 5/13

⇒ Value = [13 × (12/13) + 20 × (12/5)] ÷ [15 × (12/5) − 13 × (5/13)]

⇒ Value = [12 + 48] ÷ [36 − 5]

⇒ Value = 60/31 = 1(29/31).

**∴ The correct answer is 1(29/31).**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

Fundamental ratios in a right-angled triangle: sin θ = P/H, cos θ = B/H, tan θ = P/B.

Pythagorean Triplets

Sets of three integers satisfying a² + b² = c². Examples: (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (8, 15, 17), (7, 24, 25).

Reciprocal Identities

cot A = 1/tan A = B/P; sec A = 1/cos A = H/B; cosec A = 1/sin A = H/P.</p

questions.question: The average age of 7 members of a family is 35 years. If the youngest members are twins and they are 15 years old, then what was the average age (in years) of the family members at the time of the birth of the twins?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 7 members of family is 35 years

youngest members are twins and they are 15 years old

**Concept used:**

Sum = average × number

**Calculation:**

Total age of 7 members of family is 35 years = 35 × 7 = 245 years

At the time of birth of twins, total age of family of 5 members = 245 - 15 × 7 = 140

∴ At the time of birth of twins, Average age of family of 5 members =140/5 = 28 years

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 259876p05 is completely divisible by 11, then what is the value of (p² + 5)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by **11**, the difference between the sum of digits at **odd positions** and **even positions** must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Sum of odd positions (2, 9, 7, p, 5) = 23 + p

Sum of even positions (5, 8, 6, 0) = 19

(23 + p) − 19 = 4 + p ⇒ For divisibility, 4 + p = 11 ⇒ p = 7.

Value of (p² + 5) = 7² + 5 = 49 + 5 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number = **259876p05** is divisible by **11**.

**Divisibility Rule of 11:** Sum of digits at odd places − Sum of digits at even places = 0, 11, 22...

⇒ Let the digits be d₁=2, d₂=5, d₃=9, d₄=8, d₅=7, d₆=6, d₇=p, d₈=0, d₉=5.

⇒ Sum of odd places (S₁) = 2 + 9 + 7 + p + 5 = 23 + p

⇒ Sum of even places (S₂) = 5 + 8 + 6 + 0 = 19

⇒ Difference (D) = S₁ − S₂ = (23 + p) − 19 = 4 + p

⇒ For the number to be divisible by 11, 4 + p must be 11 (since p is a single digit 0-9).

⇒ 4 + p = 11 ⇒ p = 7

⇒ Calculation for (p² + 5):

⇒ (7)² + 5 = 49 + 5 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the **sum of all its digits** is divisible by 9.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the **last three digits** of the number are divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 11 (Alternative)

Subtract the last digit from the rest of the number; if the result is divisible by 11, the original number is too.</p

questions.question: ΔABC is drawn in a circle such that AC = BC and ∠BAC = 65°. From points B and C two tangents are drawn which intersect at point P. What is the measure of ∠BPC?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By the Alternate Segment Theorem, the angle between a tangent and a chord equals the angle subtended by that chord in the alternate segment.

⇒ ∠PBC = ∠BAC = 65°

⇒ ∠PCB = ∠BAC = 65°

In ΔBPC, the sum of all interior angles is 180°:

⇒ ∠BPC + 65° + 65° = 180°

⇒ ∠BPC = 180° − 130° = 50°

**∴ The correct answer is 50°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔABC is inscribed in a circle with center O.

AC = BC and ∠BAC = 65°.

Tangents at B and C meet at external point P.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The angle subtended by chord BC at the circumference is ∠BAC = 65°.

⇒ The angle subtended by an arc at the center is exactly double the angle subtended at the circumference.

⇒ Central Angle ∠BOC = 2 × ∠BAC = 2 × 65° = 130°.

⇒ The radius drawn to the point of contact is directly perpendicular to the tangent line.

⇒ Therefore, ∠OBP = 90° and ∠OCP = 90°.

⇒ In quadrilateral OBPC, the sum of all internal angles is strictly 360°.

⇒ ∠BOC + ∠OBP + ∠BPC + ∠OCP = 360°

⇒ 130° + 90° + ∠BPC + 90° = 360°

⇒ 310° + ∠BPC = 360°

⇒ ∠BPC = 360° − 310° = 50°

**∴ The correct answer is 50°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alternate Segment Theorem

The angle between a tangent line and a chord passing through the point of contact is perfectly equal to the angle subtended by that same chord in the alternate segment of the circle.

Angle Between Intersecting Tangents

The angle between two distinct tangents drawn from an external given point to a circle is supplementary to the central angle subtended by the chord connecting their respective points of contact (∠P + ∠O = 180°).

Inscribed Angle Theorem

The angle strictly subtended by an arc at the center is mathematically double the angle subtended by it at any remaining part of the circle's circumference.

questions.question: The side QR of a triangle PQR is extended to a point S. If ∠PRS = 104° and ∠RQP = (3)/(5) ∠QPR, then the value of ∠QPR is:
